## Part 2

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

retail_raw <- read_csv("data/retail_sales_raw.csv")

head(retail_raw)

#The class is a date

retail_raw <- read_csv(
  "data/retail_sales_raw.csv",
  na = ".",
  col_types = cols(
    observation_date = col_date(format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
    RSAFS = col_double(),
    RSAFSNA = col_double()
  )
)
```
The dataset retail_ts is from FRED and has monthly frequency with seriesid as 
the index and date as  and key. The dataset canadian_gas is directly within R
and also has monthly frequency.
